title: PCG repels foreign fishing vessel from Kota Island
summary: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) on Sunday said it has driven away an unauthorized foreign fishing vessel from the waters of Kota Island, which is part of the Kalayaan Group of Islands near Palawan.
